content.title: The Grand Finale
content.story: No circus is complete without the sweetness of the midway. Cotton candy, funnel cakes, caramel corn — the aroma of something sweet is half the show. Your troop's challenge: bring that spirit to your camp kitchen. Create a dessert that would make even the most demanding trapeze artist stop mid-swing and ask for seconds.
content.challenge: Prepare a camp-cooked dessert using Scouting field cooking methods. Judges score on taste, presentation, technique, Scout participation, and theme creativity.
content.description: Each troop prepares one dessert using camp cooking equipment (Dutch oven, camp stove, open fire, or similar field method). Scouts do the cooking — adult leaders may assist with fire safety only. Judges visit each troop's camp kitchen during the judging window, taste the dessert, and score it. Troops provide a written recipe card at the time of judging.
rules: Scouts must do the cooking — adult assistance limited to fire safety
One dessert per troop, served to the judge panel
Must use camp cooking methods — no household appliances
Serving size: enough for all judges to taste (minimum 2 oz per judge)
Provide a written recipe card describing the dessert and cooking method
All ingredients must be food-safe and pre-prepped within camp food-handling standards
Dish must be ready and presented during the designated judging window
content.time_and_scoring:
Judges visit each campsite during the designated judging window (1–2 hour block announced at check-in).

Scoring (100 points total):
- Taste & Flavor: 0–30 pts
- Presentation & Appearance: 0–20 pts
- Camp Cooking Technique: 0–20 pts
- Scout Participation (Scouts cooking, not adults): 0–20 pts
- Circus / Theme Creativity: 0–10 pts

Tiebreaker: Judges' discretion.
content.setup: Same judging window as Best Entrée, or a separate window. Judges move from campsite to campsite. Bring palate cleansers.
content.reset: Judges move to next campsite. No physical reset.
content.staffing: 2–3 adult judges. Score independently; average or discuss at end.
content.supplies_text:
Scoring sheets (1 per judge per troop): 1 pad
Pens: 1 per judge
Water bottles: 1 per judge
Plain crackers (palate cleansers): 1 sleeve
Clipboards: 1 per judge
Summary tally sheet: 1
